text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the 'Japanese Derby'.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see Sounds of Earth's video? It's 
seriously great for getting to know the 
competing Umamusume in detail.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Of course I watched it~! That's how I 
found my favorite for this year!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I knew I was just a casual 
fan, but thanks to Earth, I feel like I'm 
enjoying watching the races way more than 
before~.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! How do I put it... she 
teaches us so much from an Umamusume's 
perspective, that's what makes it so fun!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —It's finally time, Direttore.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —It's finally time, Direttrice.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: No, I'm nothing but thrilled...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can only imagine what kind of amazing 
session we'll create today!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufuâ Then let us enjoy it together. 
Today's session, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The one and only Japan Derby... that you 
and I reached together...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Sounds of Earth say that, a single 
thing I wanted to tell her welled up from 
within my chest—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Sounds of Earth and her generation 
worked tirelessly to make today's Derby an 
exhilarating experience for everyone 
watching."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter who wins, it's bound to be an 
amazing race. I'm certain of that. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one I'm cheering for the most, the one 
I want to win more than anyone else, is 
Sounds of Earth and Earth alone...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That core belief alone, as her Trainer, 
will never waver...!!
choice_data_list: —So have fun, and go win this!
—So have fun, and go win this!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —I will answer that love.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
With all my love, I dedicate today's music 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That's why— gaze upon me from the closest 
spot, with the burning passion in your 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"...Give it your all, everyone. Show them 
just how amazing our generation is...!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
……I will "observe". No matter what form it 
takes――

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: âThey really did it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean by "did it"?

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"...Lately, a lot of different people have 
started telling me, 'I'm rooting for 
you.'"

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
They said they all learned about me... 
about me and you, Trainer, through Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"It simply means your bond looked just 
that bellissima to everyone."

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
...Look who's talking. Thanks to that, 
I'm—

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Which makes me all the more fired up, 
because losing is simply not an option!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (――What a lovely sound.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then let us hear that fiery melody echo 
across the turf to your heart's 
content...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Forza, iniziamo la sessione!
